items.summary: OAuth2 SSRF in the SAP Cloud SDK for Python (before 0.45.2): an attacker controlling the tenant_subdomain parameter can redirect OAuth2 token requests to an attacker-controlled server, exfiltrating client credentials from multi-tenant BTP apps with no login required.

NVIDIA AIStore (Linux) legacy ETL Kubernetes PodSpec initialization API lets a remote attacker supply Kubernetes host-namespace and container-security settings, enabling code execution, privilege escalation, and data tampering across the AIStore storage layer.

Improper certificate validation in Microsoft Partner Center lets an unauthorized attacker elevate privileges over the network (October 2026 Patch Tuesday). Affects a broadly-deployed Microsoft partner management service.

SAP S/4HANA (Manage Substitution/Validation Rules, S4CORE 105-109) insufficiently validates input to its domain-specific scripting language; an authenticated attacker with specific business privileges can get crafted input interpreted as arbitrary ABAP code, enabling full system compromise.

The "Click to Chat for WhatsApp" WordPress plugin (up to 4.44) is vulnerable to unauthenticated arbitrary shortcode execution: attacker-controlled URL bytes from REQUEST_URI reach do_shortcode() unfiltered via the greetings templates.
